ruling.recommended_action: Close the dispute as not upheld; no fare adjustment. Optionally send an advisory note to the driver on the RD-1 shortest-and-most-direct-route obligation, since his "I followed the app route exactly" claim conflicts with the GPS trace.

segment_findings.reason: GPS trace between ~17:21:00 and 17:22:00 (thinned samples 1.34959,103.94519 / 1.34850,103.94682 / 1.34955,103.94988) departs from the quoted route's alignment around (1.3503,103.9448)-(1.3481,103.9457) by ≈0.4-0.6 km before rejoining at (1.3495,103.9499). No rider-named stop or driver-proposed-and-accepted change in chat (RD-3/RD-5 not satisfied), no incident and no qualifying band on the substituted stretch, and heavy rain is not a listed exemption (RD-4(c)); the PIE band-5 record does not cover the earlier segment. Recorded as an RD-1 breach, but the measured extra distance (~0.2-0.6 km) straddles the data-layer map-matching noise tolerance, so under RD-2 the refundable mileage (≈$0.28-$0.85 at $1.41/km) is not established to the confidence needed for a fare adjustment.
